brief:
The Guardian reported that the creator of Netflix comedy "Nobody Wants This" disagreed with lead actor Adam Brody's recent comments expressing support for Palestine. Brody had criticized the "death and misery" occurring there, prompting the show's Jewish creator to publicly distance themselves from his position.

The exchange reflected broader tensions within the entertainment industry over the Israeli-Palestinian conflict, with cast and crew holding differing views on the ongoing situation.
